motion.name: sube
motion.value: opacity 1s, translate 0 28px -> 0 1.2s, filter blur(8px) -> none 1s; once at 18% visibility, rootMargin -6% bottom
motion.purpose: Heat-rise entrance for headings, copy and actions.

motion.name: vapor
motion.value: 4.8s loop, strokes offset 1.6s; translateY 30% -> -35%, scaleY .6 -> 1.15, peak opacity .85 at 25%

motion.name: gira
motion.value: rotate(c * 38deg * ±1), c = distance of pot center from viewport center in viewports
motion.purpose: Cazuelas turning with scroll, alternating direction.

motion.name: movil-rise
motion.value: translateY(140%) -> none .6s; shown when scrollY > 80vh and the closing section top > 70vh
motion.purpose: Mobile call bar rising into view.

motion.name: flota
motion.value: opacity .35s, scale .85 -> 1 .5s, rotate -4deg -> 3deg .6s; position lerp .14 per frame
motion.purpose: Dish photo following the pointer over rows (desktop, fine pointer).

motion.name: fuego
motion.value: WebGL fbm flame shader at 0.5x resolution; level hero .86 desktop/.64 mobile x (1 - .7 x scroll progress); closing .3 + .55 x section progress
motion.purpose: Live fire that burns down on scroll and relights at the closing call.

motion.name: chispas
motion.value: 2D additive particles, cap 220, 26/s x level, rise 40-130px/s, life 1.6-4.6s, gold -> red
motion.purpose: Embers drifting up through the hero.

motion.name: atizar
motion.value: pointer bump exp(-dx^2*6) x .42 height; heat += speed/900 (decay .35^dt); ptr += speed/260 (decay .25^dt); up to 6 strong embers per move

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.value: still fire frame, no embers or hint, entrances final, steam .45 static, no rotation, scroll-behavior auto

breakpoints.purpose: Single column, nav hidden, mobile call bar, row thumbnails.

narrative.overview:
The site is the wood fire itself. A soot-black ground holds a live WebGL fire that rises from the bottom edge of the first and last sections, embers drift up through the copy, and the visitor can stoke it ("atizar") with a finger or the mouse. Between those two fires, whole sections are fired in barro terracotta, and the dishes appear as round clay cazuelas cut out of their photos, turning slowly as the page scrolls and breathing steam. Nothing is boxed. Light belongs to the fire, and the one saturated non-fire color is the logo's chili red, kept for the call to phone.

The density is low and the type is loud: a heavy, narrowed Bricolage Grotesque set very large and tight, with a plain full-width cut of the same family for reading. Every authored movement rises like heat, slowly and with a long ease-out, and never slides in from the side. The page is built for a phone in a hand on the street. A fixed chili-red call bar rises into view on mobile once the hero is passed and steps aside at the closing call.

The surface brief rejects the restaurant template (a stock food hero, a card grid, a map embed). The build carries that through: dishes are cut-out pots, rows and arch-framed photos, never a grid of boxed cards.
keyCharacteristics: Soot ground, terracotta fields, firelight as the only glow.
One red action: chili-red pill buttons with the number always visible.
Heavy, narrowed grotesk display (wdth 82, opsz 96) over a full-width body cut (wdth 100).
Hearth-arch contours, pills, hairline rules; no card boxes.
Live fire, embers, steam and turning pots; every entrance rises.

rules.name: The Named Inks Rule
rules.body: Every color on the page is one of the tokens above or a low-alpha version of one. Hairlines are ceniza at alpha, shadows are soot or deep clay at alpha, and glows are ember light at alpha. Never add a free grey or a new hue.

rules.name: The Firelight Rule
rules.body: Orange is light, not paint. Lumbre glow appears only as radial light or flame; ascua only marks something lit (one word, the stars, focus, hover). No orange fills, orange buttons or orange section bands.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Guindilla means "phone us". If something is chili red, tapping it calls 926 82 15 30.

rules.name: The Narrow Fire, Wide Ash Rule
rules.body: Display roles narrow (wdth 78 to 88) and run at opsz 96; reading text is always wdth 100. Never set body copy condensed, and never set a heading at full width.

rules.name: The Visible Number Rule
rules.body: The phone number is set in tabular figures inside the call button itself. On the desktop and mobile call pills the number is always visible; on the narrow header pill the word "Reservar" is dropped and the number stays.

rules.name: The Lit From Below Rule
rules.body: Glows sit at the bottom of a section (radial gradients anchored at 110% to 115% from the top) because fire is on the floor. Never light a section from the top with orange.

rules.name: The Arch Not Box Rule
rules.body: Photos are framed as hearth arches; dishes are cut-out pots or ruled rows. A plain rectangular card is never the frame for food.

dos: Do keep every color within the named inks; tint with alpha (hairlines are ceniza at 0.08 to 0.30) rather than adding a grey.
Do use guindilla only for tel: actions, with white label text and the number in tabular figures inside the pill.
Do frame food photos as hearth arches (`rounded.hearth`, `rounded.hearth-low`) and set dishes as cut-out pots or ruled rows.
Do let whole sections be fields of barro or barro hondo, with sobre-barro body text on them.
Do set headings in Bricolage Grotesque 800 at wdth 82 and opsz 96, line height 0.95, tracking -0.018em; set body at wdth 100.
Do make every authored entrance rise (Sube: 28px, 8px blur, house ease), and honor prefers-reduced-motion with final states and a still fire.
Do light sections from below with ember glows at 0.25 alpha or less, and keep the fire canvas at the bottom edge.
Do keep the call one tap away on mobile with the fixed full-width call bar.
donts: Don't use orange as a fill, button or text block; ember color is light (glows, flame, the stars, focus, one lit word).
Don't put a grid of boxed cards on the page for dishes, photos or reviews; the restaurant-template stock hero, card grid and map are what this world refuses.
Don't slide authored entrances in sideways; motion rises. User-driven horizontal scrolling in the gallery strip is fine.
Don't use chili red for anything that does not call the restaurant.
Don't add hard-edged or offset shadows; depth is soft soot or deep-clay drops and firelight.
Don't set reading text condensed or headings at full width.
